scientific_limitations: The gap statistics require nonoverlined appearances; overlined-only appearances are counted as missing.
The sharp covariance theorem is an asymptotic, not a finite-size equality or a uniform error estimate.
Earlier work supplies the single-mex generating function, overpartition log-concavity, and Rademacher expansion; these are not claimed as discoveries.
Unindexed general theorems for random partition conditioning may contain equivalent statements.
The direct verification checks are finite; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sharp residual dependence of odd and even nonoverlined gaps in overpartitions
